Hi @sunku5494. Thanks for your PR.

I'm waiting for a [openshift-assisted](https://github.com/orgs/openshift-assisted/people) member to verify that this patch is reasonable to test. If it is, they should reply with `/ok-to-test` on its own line. Until that is done, I will not automatically test new commits in this PR, but the usual testing commands by org members will still work.

>[!TIP]
>**We noticed you've done this a few times! Consider [joining the org](https://github.com/orgs/openshift-assisted/people) to skip this step and gain `/lgtm` and other bot rights.** We recommend asking approvers on your previous PRs to sponsor you.

Once the patch is verified, the new status will be reflected by the `ok-to-test` label.

I understand the commands that are listed [here](https://go.k8s.io/bot-commands?repo=openshift-assisted%2Fassisted-installer-ui).
